Name: ITEMTABLE_PARAM_ST
Description: Weighted item tables used by item lots. A row can be limited to one hero or one weapon type, needs its event flag on and its exclude flag off, and can be kept from being picked twice in one roll.

Fields.Name: Item Category
Fields.Description: Category of the item this row gives (ITEM_CATEGORY; with 7, Item ID is another ItemTableParam table).

Fields.Name: Item ID
Fields.Description: ID of the item this row gives, in the param chosen by Item Category.

Fields.Name: Roll Weight
Fields.Description: Weight of this row in the roll, against the sum of the table's eligible rows. 0: never rolled.

Fields.Name: Quantity
Fields.Description: Number of the item given when this row is picked.

Fields.Name: Only For Hero
Fields.Description: Hero the row is limited to: it is only eligible when the roll is made for that hero. 0: any hero (and only these rows take part in rolls made without a hero).

Fields.Name: Required Event Flag ID
Fields.Description: Event flag that must be on for the row to be eligible. 0: no condition. Retail: 9070–9099 on some table rows, 10001812/10001813 on Old Pocketwatch.

Fields.Name: Duplicate Group ID
Fields.Description: Used with No Duplicates: rows with the same group ID count as the same pick. -1 compares the item itself (category and ID). Retail: -1 on every row.

Fields.Name: No Duplicates
Fields.Description: If set, this row can't be picked when a row with the same Duplicate Group ID (or the same item, when that is -1) was already picked earlier in the same roll through nested tables. Only bit 0 is read. Retail: set on 189 Permanent Buff table rows.

Fields.Name: Excluding Event Flag ID
Fields.Description: Event flag that makes the row ineligible while it is on. 0: no condition.

Fields.Name: Required Weapon Type
Fields.Description: Weapon type the row is limited to: it is only eligible when the roll asks for that weapon type. −1: any (and only these rows take part in rolls without a weapon type).
